hypothesis: Replacing the raw retarded Ricker with its causal two-dimensional Green half-integral will reduce per-record oracle-scaled median calibration relative L2 below 0.5.
expected_mechanism: The pressure solution is the source term convolved with the 2D wave-equation Green tail proportional to H(t-T)/sqrt(t-T); the half-integral corrects the waveform phase/order absent from r43/r46.

single_conceptual_variable.name: analytic_template
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: causal 2D Green convolution of the Ricker source

primary_metric: median train-only calibration relative L2 after per-record oracle scaling
rollback: Preserve r46; if rejected, stop analytic single-arrival templates and train the learned multi-arrival propagator under the same train-only split.
